name: cloister
description: Default burden bank for Cloister (monastic scenario). Sins, doubts, and visions appropriate to a religious order.

burdens.text: Before I took vows, I caused a death. The family does not know it was me.
I no longer believe what I preach. I continue because the structure feeds me.
I saw the Abbot in my last vision, kneeling at the altar weeping. I do not know what it means.
I have read the heretical texts the Abbot ordered burned. I kept one. I read it on the nights I cannot sleep.
I broke my fast last week. Three days early. I lied to Brother Lucian when he asked.
An old monk who taught me prophesied I would die unredeemed. I have spent thirty years trying to disprove him.
I am writing letters to my mother in secret, in violation of the Rule. She does not know I am here.
